title: Volume of Cube
description: Calculates the volume of a cube using the length of one side.

example.question: Find the volume of a cube with side 6 cm.

note: A cube has equal length, width, and height.

title: Volume of Cuboid
description: Calculates the volume of a cuboid using its length, breadth, and height.

example.question: Find the volume of a cuboid with length 10 cm, breadth 6 cm and height 8 cm.

note: Volume is the product of length, breadth, and height.

title: Volume of Cylinder
description: Calculates the volume of a cylinder using its radius and height.

example.question: Find the volume of a cylinder with radius 7 cm and height 10 cm.

note: Volume equals the area of the circular base multiplied by the height.

title: Volume of Cone
description: Calculates the volume of a cone using its radius and perpendicular height.

example.question: Find the volume of a cone with radius 7 cm and height 12 cm.

note: A cone has one-third the volume of a cylinder with the same base and height.

title: Volume of Sphere
description: Calculates the volume of a sphere using its radius.

example.question: Find the volume of a sphere with radius 7 cm.

note: All points on the surface of a sphere are equidistant from its center.

title: Volume of Hemisphere
description: Calculates the volume of a hemisphere using its radius.

example.question: Find the volume of a hemisphere with radius 7 cm.

note: A hemisphere has exactly half the volume of a sphere with the same radius.
